trigger: Explicit development transition after parent checkpoint 800: 1/40 dual-reader addition and 0/10 copying; no independent evaluation seen
initialization: verified parent checkpoint 800, selected by the fixed local development panel
reason: At 200 copying updates, decreasing flow loss did not produce readable correct glyphs; add a training-only loss separating correct answer images from the other answer images
objective: original masked flow MSE plus 0.25 cross-entropy of negative answer-region latent distances to twenty fixed image prototypes, temperature 0.025
prototypes: averages of canonical training target VAE latents for each subtotal; used only during optimization, never generation
checkpoint_selection: fixed development endpoints at 400, 1200, 2400 and 4000; addition then copy exactness; first on ties
inference: unchanged pretrained SANA plus trained adapters; clean raster context and noise only; twelve Euler steps; no prototypes, answer candidates, OCR, solver or verifier
claim_boundary: development adaptation of a pretrained image diffusion model; no claim of pretraining benefit, withheld elementary-fact induction, or autonomous routing
prior_plan_preserved: prototype-protocol-original.json records the earlier conditional 1200-update plan; revised before any prototype-arm optimizer update
